en.t: GAMCO details 13.5 lakh sq ft Kolkata residential pipeline
en.s: GAMCO has outlined 13.5 lakh sq ft of planned Kolkata housing, led by a 12.5 lakh sq ft, 500-unit premium project.

en.s: Probe concerns alleged illegal overseas transfers of `569.03 crore through forged software import documents

en.t: Kolkata’s iconic yellow taxi through the lens of Ananth Padmanabhan’s No Refusal
en.s: Ananth Padmanabhan’s photo exhibition 'No Refusal' in Delhi celebrates Kolkata's iconic yellow taxis. Step into the nostalgia and discover more.

en.t: "Rahul Gandhi acting as toolkit of foreign forces": Nitin Nabin in Kolkata
en.s: BJP national president Nitin Nabin on Monday launched a sharp attack on Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi during the party's 'Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao' march in Kolkata, accusing him of sympathising with forces creating unrest abroad.

en.t: Mamata's plaque at Nandan painted over ahead of Kolkata film festtival
en.s: A political controversy has erupted in West Bengal after a plaque bearing former Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee's name at Kolkata's Nandan cultural hub was painted over, while one for Jyoti Basu remained untouched. This incident, occurring just before the Kolkata International Film Festival, has…

en.t: Reeling under multiple fines, Kolkata bus owners urge cops to target drivers
en.s: Kolkata bus unions seek relief from mounting traffic fines, allege multiple e-challans; police cite violations. Govt considers 40% waiver and driver training.

en.t: Akasa Air flight from Ahmedabad grounded at Kolkata airport following tail strike post-landing; passenger
en.s: Akasa Air Boeing 737 MAX 8 from Ahmedabad to Kolkata was grounded after a post-landing tail strike; passengers disembarked safely, probe underway.

en.t: Jack Preger, street doc who took care of Kolkata’s poorest, dies in UK
en.s: Dr Jack Preger, Kolkata’s “Pavement Doctor” and founder of Calcutta Rescue, dies aged 96 in Norfolk, UK, after decades serving the city’s poorest.

en.t: Airfares to Kolkata soar on Nov festive demand
en.s: Airfares to Kolkata nearly double ahead of Kali Puja and Bhaiphonta (Nov 8–10), with festive demand pushing fares up 40–80% on key routes.
